knownLimits: Representative alternate-theme evidence does not establish every state/family/theme.
Existing raster imagery requires replacement or creative adaptation; color variables do not regenerate images.
Vector wordmarks remain authored assets; replace asset masters rather than regenerating logos from typography tokens.
Brand illustration, photography/casting and detailed voice/tone decisions need owner definition or not-applicable decisions.
Packaging and video examples are design studies, not production print or encoded-video deliverables.
Public adaptation agent is a contract and questionnaire; hosted execution is not deployed.
Figma native Specs/Git mirrors require explicit synchronization.
